shared_saved_construction.source: Papyrus++ 2024.2, Zenodo record 13987985; native ChEMBL activity linkage. The saved source filename is 05.7++_combined_set_without_stereochemistry.tsv.xz.
shared_saved_construction.high_evidence: The 116 previously reviewed high-evidence input groups were already in Pack 01, not an additional cohort and not all Papyrus-derived. One of the 116 group labels also includes a batch-source contribution.
shared_saved_construction.admission: Exact positive finite equality Kd/Ki, accepted concentration units; no IC50/EC50/KIBA or inferred Ki. Papyrus high quality; unique native ChEMBL linkage; no flagged data_validity_comment or potential_duplicate; single protein, confidence_score=9 and relationship_type=D, checked species/sequence/UniProt; annotated variants, complexes and known identity/value conflicts excluded. The high-evidence component retains its original review rules.
shared_saved_construction.structure: RDKit 2025.03.5 Cleanup/FragmentParent/Uncharger and canonical isomeric comparison-parent SMILES after native structure linkage. The source filename does not establish two-dimensional model input; 2D SMILES was used only in conservative dependency grouping.
shared_saved_construction.labels: modeling_summary_p is the deterministic median of retained source pAffinity within full-stereo comparison-parent/canonical-UniProt/endpoint; ChEMBL activity_id deduplicates native measurements including multiple Papyrus positions. Kd/Ki stay separate and the delivered p scale was not logarithmized again.
shared_saved_construction.pack_assignment: Fixed study round-robin, then target round-robin within study, then SHA256 order; pack identities are delivery units rather than independent experimental replications.
